notes.title: Demo Patch V0.23
notes.notes:
Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu Demo V0.23 Patch Notes

Fixed bug where pausing game or using photomode while using a pineapple balloon causes the contestant to fly into orbit

Cleaned up some sora audio

Added new customisation options, tails, ears, backpacks!

Improved baked lighting in Yolko Harbour

Improved cloth physics performance

Fixed the issue where cloth physics would briefly stretch toward the ground in an ugly way

Waving octopus arm hazard now is always emerged instead of popping up when players are nearby

Fixed a problem with loaded stages  ignoring user's volume settings

Added necessary invisible walls to Yolko Harbour
